Compositing and task graphs, For-Each loops, materials per group, and built-in documentation.

**New contexts**
- **IMG**: compositing in **COP Networks**, shown in the viewport. File, Render (the latest MoonRay render), Constant, Ramp, Noise, Composite (over, add, multiply, screen…), Chroma Key, Color Correct, Levels, Invert, Blur, Sharpen, Glow, Edge Detect, Vignette, Grain, Transform, Crop, Resize, Switch and File Output (EXR, PNG, JPG; one file per frame with $F).
- **TASKS**: task graphs in **TOP Networks**. Frame Range, Wedge (vary any node's parameter), Fetch (run a MoonRay render or File Export per work item), Command, File Pattern, Wait for All and FFmpeg Encode. Cook the last node; each work item shows as a dot that turns green when done.

**Geometry networks**
- **Flow Control**: For-Each Connected Piece, Named Primitive, Point, Primitive and Number, For Loop with Feedback, and Compile Blocks (cached, and loops inside run in parallel).
- **Material**: assign MAT materials to groups of primitives, overriding the object's material, in renders, the viewport and USD.
- **Object Merge**: bring in other objects' geometry, optionally in this object's space.
- **Measure**: area, perimeter, point area, curvature, gradient, volume and curve length.
- **Add**: place points at given positions, add them to an input, or delete the input's polygons but keep its points.

**Also**
- **Help → Documentation**: every node and VEX function on a searchable web page, generated from the app.
- **VEX**: function overloading (same name, different parameter types).
- **Node names**: rename any node (F2, or the Name field).
- **Searching**: the right-click add menu has a search box; TAB search matches every word and category names.
- Shader nodes no longer appear in geometry networks.
